grounding_evidence.source_document: Horizon Tech Ltd was founded in Colorado in 2018. It reported annual revenue of $4.2M with 48 full-time employees. The company maintains an active SOC 2 Type II certification verified by Ernst & Young in November 2025. It has had a single commercial litigation in 2023 settled out of court for $15,000 involving delayed software deliverables. No regulatory sanctions or tax liens exist.
